dct_title_s: Malaysia Floods: Flood Proxy Map, Jan 2021
dct_description_sm: # ARIA-SG Flood Proxy Map: Malaysia, Floods, 7 Jan 2021, v0.7 Derived from synthetic aperture radar data acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellites operated by the European Space Agency (ESA) from 1 Jan 2020 to 7 Jan 2021. Analysed by the ARIA-SG team at the Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) in collaboration with NASA-JPL and Caltech. Data processing used an AWS Open Dataset of Copernicus Sentinel-1 data for the Asia region (https://registry.opendata.aws/sentinel1-slc-seasia-pds). **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:**
